title.narrative: Enhancing participation of Guatemala in Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe programmes

description.narrative: Contract related to: Enhancing participation of Guatemala in Erasmus+ and Horizon Europe programmes - The Specific Objectives of this action are to provide support to the effective preparation/formulation, implementation and management of the EU-Guatemala cooperation, and to increase public knowledge and perception of the EU cooperation with Guatemala while enhancing the capacities of the Government and relevant stakeholders to efficiently implement national development objectives, through strategic communication and public diplomacy activities.RIDER 1: Extension of the implementation period of ACT - 60596: Due to the delay suffered regarding the availability of credits for the implementation of Decision C(2022) 8217 signed on November 10, 2022, and the necessary time to go through the relevant contracting procedures, it is necessary to extend the implementation period of the decision from 36 to 60 months. RIDER 2: Modification of implementation modes; to include indirect management.RIDER 3: Budget Updating: Reallocation of funds within the same action provided that it does not increase/decrease the global budgetary envelope.
